name: Bulk Update User Roles
description: Admin form that bulk-assigns or bulk-removes one or more roles across selected users or all users at once, processed as a Batch API job. Depends only on core User.
project_description:
The Bulk Update User Roles module enables site administrators to assign or remove roles for multiple users at once, either in bulk or by selecting users individually.

Features
Assign or remove one or more roles for many users in a single submission, processed with the Batch API. Choose specific users from a list, or apply the change to all users.

Post-Installation
After the module is installed go to Administration > Configuration > People > Bulk Update User Roles to assign or remove roles.
